replies.author: Kammeh
replies.body:
I really enjoy this hub! It's a perfect size and you have so much to do. Sometimes I spend more time in the hub than actually playing gamemodes. The aesthetics are great, it's not too fancy nor too bland. They match and blend with each other, and give off a pleasant aura. 
I would rate the hub 9-9.5/10
